page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.2xlarge is an x86_64 storage-focused virtual instance within the Local SSDs family, running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor providing 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. Compute resources are paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU allocation, and an integrated 1919 GB local SSD. It includes no dedicated GPU accelerators and provides a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations indicate modest compute capabilities consistent with its processor generation. The instance achieved 960.0 in Geekbench single-core and 3613.0 in Geekbench multi-core testing, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 6991.89. In stress-ng, it registered 1107.49 on single-core and 5883.4 on multi-core tests, placing general CPU throughput in lower tiers. Memory testing measured 328.53 GB/sec for cached read-only blocks, 39.23 GB/sec on large uncached blocks, and 35.45 GB/sec on large block writes. While data compression tasks exhibit lower throughput, in-memory operations remain stable, with Redis SET benchmarks recording 6.06 million operations per second.

In terms of resource architecture, ecs.i2.2xlarge emphasizes storage capacity and memory density over high-frequency compute. The integrated 1919 GB local SSD provides direct storage access without the latency overhead of network storage volumes. However, single-threaded processing and a 2 Gbps baseline network interface represent potential operational boundaries. This configuration is best matched with I/O-heavy transactional databases, in-memory caching tiers, and localized data stores that require paired solid-state disk capacity and generous memory.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.2xlarge is a local-storage-oriented instance from the Local SSDs family running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 x86_64 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, delivering 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores, alongside 64.0 GB of RAM. The instance includes a bundled 1919 GB local SSD, baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps, and no GPU hardware. Benchmark results indicate modest CPU execution performance, scoring 960.0 in Geekbench single-core, 3613.0 in multi-core, and 6991.89 in PassMark CPU tests. Memory write throughput holds at 35.45 GB/sec on large blocks, enabling 6.06 million Redis SET operations per second. While compute and compression speeds place in lower tiers, the dense local SSD capacity and high memory allocation make this instance suitable for I/O-intensive databases, caching clusters, and low-latency local storage workloads.
